findings.quote: Using g alone instead of g + a gives 19 N and 47.5 N
findings.note: Using g alone gives 2.0 × 9.8 = 19.6 N and 5.0 × 9.8 = 49 N. The stated cause cannot produce 19 N or 47.5 N.
findings.fix: Using g alone instead of g + a gives 19.6 N and 49 N, ignoring that the whole system accelerates upward.
